room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (Gold ≤5L); Single Private AC Room (Gold >5L & Platinum)
room_rent.note: Gold plan up to ₹5L: 1% SI/day room, 2% SI/day ICU. Gold >5L and Platinum: Single Private AC Room with proportionate deduction for higher categories.

icu.note: Gold plan up to ₹5L: ICU capped at 2% of SI per day. Gold >5L and Platinum: ICU at actuals.

copayment.display: 30% mandatory (waived for accidents; sublimit procedures exempt; joint replacement has additional 30% Gold / 20% Platinum)
copayment.note: 30% co-pay on all admissible claims except accident claims and procedures with defined sublimits. Joint replacement attracts additional co-pay of 30% (Gold) or 20% (Platinum). Optional cover 2.B.2 can reduce co-pay; optional cover 2.B.9 can increase it.

sub_limits.display: Cataract (per eye/yr), major surgeries, hernia/hysterectomy/prostate — limits per Product Benefits Table
sub_limits.note: Sublimits apply to: cataract (per eye per policy year), major surgeries (cancer, CVA, cardiovascular, renal, intestinal obstruction, bilio-pancreatic, GI, genitourinary), hernia/hysterectomy/prostate procedures. Exact ₹ amounts in Policy Schedule/Product Benefits Table.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months (per Section 3.1.1 which states 'excluded until the expiry of 12 months'). Portability/migration credits apply.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, stones, osteoarthritis, knee/hip replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months from policy inception.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are explicitly excluded under Section 3.1.18 (Standard Exclusion Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Optional cover 2.B.7: 10% of SI per claim-free year, up to 100% of SI. Applicable only on Section 2.A base covers. Forfeited if policy lapses. Not available if optional cover not renewed beyond one year.

restoration.note: Optional cover 2.B.6: 100% recharge of SI once per policy year. Not available for same illness/injury for which a claim was already paid in that year. Not carried forward if unused.

pre_hosp.display: Not specified (days per Product Benefits Table)
pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation cover exists under Section 2.A.2 but exact number of days is referenced to Policy Schedule/Product Benefits Table, not stated in wording.

post_hosp.display: Not specified (days per Product Benefits Table); 90 days with optional cover 2.B.1 (Gold only)
post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation cover under Section 2.A.3; exact base days in Policy Schedule/Product Benefits Table. Optional cover 2.B.1 (Gold plan only) extends to 90 days.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered under Section 2.A.4 for procedures listed in Annexure III. OPD treatment excluded.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered under Section 2.A.6 if treatment continues uninterrupted for at least 3 days and patient cannot be moved to hospital or hospital bed unavailable.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient AYUSH hospitals)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered under Section 2.A.7 at government/teaching/registered AYUSH hospitals meeting NABH/NQAS criteria.

organ_donor.note: Section 2.A.13 covers inpatient hospitalisation expenses of organ donor for insured's transplant. Pre/post-hospitalisation and screening of donor excluded.

ambulance.display: Covered up to limit in Policy Schedule (road); air ambulance in Platinum plan
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered under Section 2.A.5 up to limit in Product Benefits Table. Platinum plan also covers air/helicopter ambulance subject to conditions. Exact ₹ limit not stated in wording.

modern_treatments.display: Covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic, oral chemo, immunotherapy, etc.)
modern_treatments.note: Section 2.A.8 covers modern treatments including robotic surgeries, stereotactic radiosurgery, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions.

consumables.note: Optional cover 2.B.8 covers items listed in Annexure II List I (gloves, consumables, etc.) under inpatient and day care. Not covered in base plan.

global_cover.display: Not covered (India only; treatment outside India excluded per 3.2.23)
global_cover.note: Section 3.2.23 explicitly excludes treatment received outside India. Section 4.2.6 confirms geographical scope is India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.display: 30 days (15 days for monthly premium mode)
grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Free look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before but not earlier than 60 days from renewal date.

notable_exclusions.display: Sleep apnea/snoring, treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, maternity, hereditary diseases (Haemophilia, Cystic kidneys etc.), OPD treatment, artificial life maintenance

optional_riders.display: Enhanced post-hosp (90 days, Gold only), Co-pay reduction, Nursing at home, Hospital daily cash, OPD cover, Recharge of SI (100%), Cumulative bonus (10%/yr up to 100%), Non-payable expense cover, Co-pay increase
